value_en: King Charles III is Canada's Head of State (King of Canada).
value_fr: Le roi Charles III est le chef d'État du Canada (roi du Canada).
note: Corroborated by gg.ca installation coverage (King Charles III approved the new GG's appointment; 'God Save the King' played at the June 2026 installation).

value_en: The Right Honourable Louise Arbour is the Governor General of Canada (31st since Confederation), installed June 8, 2026.
value_fr: La très honorable Louise Arbour est la gouverneure générale du Canada (31e depuis la Confédération), installée le 8 juin 2026.
note: TRANSITION COMPLETE: Mary Simon's term ended mid-2026; Louise Arbour was announced May 5, 2026 by PM Carney, and installed as 31st Governor General on June 8, 2026. gg.ca live homepage now shows 'Her Excellency the Right Honourable Louise Arbour'. Any question/answer citing Mary Simon is now WRONG.

value_en: Mark Carney is the Prime Minister of Canada (Liberal Party of Canada), in office since March 2025.
value_fr: Mark Carney est le premier ministre du Canada (Parti libéral du Canada), en fonction depuis mars 2025.
note: 24th Prime Minister. pm.gc.ca confirmed live via search index; still PM as of Aug 2026 news coverage.

value_en: The Liberal Party of Canada forms the government. Elected as a minority in April 2025; holds a majority of House seats since April 2026 via by-election wins and floor crossings (currently 173 of 343 with 5 seats vacant).
value_fr: Le Parti libéral du Canada forme le gouvernement. Élu minoritaire en avril 2025, il détient la majorité des sièges depuis avril 2026 grâce à des élections partielles et à des changements d'allégeance (actuellement 173 sièges sur 343, 5 sièges vacants).
note: IMPORTANT nuance: no general election occurred in 2026. The 'majority' arose mid-Parliament (by-elections of April 13, 2026 + defections). For test questions, the safe phrasing is 'the Liberal Party under Mark Carney forms the government'.

value_en: The most recent federal general election was held on April 28, 2025 (45th general election). The Liberal Party under Mark Carney won the most seats (169 of 343) and formed a minority government.
value_fr: La plus récente élection générale fédérale a eu lieu le 28 avril 2025 (45e élection générale). Le Parti libéral, dirigé par Mark Carney, a remporté le plus grand nombre de sièges (169 sur 343) et a formé un gouvernement minoritaire.
note: Verified no newer general election as of 2026-08-28 (a CNN Apr 2026 'majority' headline refers to by-elections, not a general election). Next fixed-date election: on or before Oct 2029 unless called earlier.

value_en: The House of Commons has 343 seats. Current standings (Sept 4, 2026): Liberal 173, Conservative 138, Bloc Québécois 21, NDP 5, Green 1, vacant 5.
value_fr: La Chambre des communes compte 343 sièges. Répartition actuelle (4 septembre 2026) : libéraux 173, conservateurs 138, Bloc Québécois 21, NPD 5, Parti vert 1, 5 sièges vacants.
note: Seat total rose from 338 to 343 with the 2022 redistribution, first used in the April 2025 election. Party standings are volatile; the 343 total is the stable fact to test.

value_en: The Senate of Canada has 105 seats.
value_fr: Le Sénat du Canada compte 105 sièges.
note: sencanada.ca live: 'Canada's 105 senators give regions and underrepresented groups a strong voice in Parliament.' Vacancy count not shown on page.

value_en: Pierre Poilievre (Conservative Party of Canada, MP for Battle River—Crowfoot) is the Leader of the Official Opposition.
value_fr: Pierre Poilievre (Parti conservateur du Canada, député de Battle River—Crowfoot) est le chef de l'opposition officielle.
note: Conservatives confirmed as largest opposition party (139 seats) on ourcommons.ca live standings. Poilievre lost his Carleton seat in April 2025, returned via the Battle River—Crowfoot by-election and resumed as Opposition Leader in August 2025 (Andrew Scheer was interim in between); still leader as of Aug 2026.

value_en: The citizenship test has 20 questions (multiple choice and true/false), based on the official study guide Discover Canada.
value_fr: L'examen pour la citoyenneté comporte 20 questions (choix multiples et vrai ou faux), fondées sur le guide d'étude officiel Découvrir le Canada.
note: canada.ca blocks automated fetch (403); verified via search snippets of the live canada.ca test pages.

value_en: You must answer at least 15 of the 20 questions correctly to pass the citizenship test (75%).
value_fr: Vous devez répondre correctement à au moins 15 des 20 questions pour réussir l'examen (75 %).
note: Verified via live canada.ca content in search index, 2026-08-28.

value_en: The online citizenship test has a 45-minute time limit (it auto-submits when time runs out). The in-person written test is 30 minutes.
value_fr: L'examen en ligne pour la citoyenneté a une limite de 45 minutes (il est soumis automatiquement à la fin du temps). L'examen écrit en personne dure 30 minutes.
note: 45-minute online countdown confirmed on the live 'Take the online test' page. The 30-minute in-person figure comes from IRCC's general test description; if quizzing on time limit, prefer the online 45-minute figure or specify the format in the question.

value_en: Applicants get up to 3 chances to pass the citizenship test; after a third failure, IRCC schedules a hearing with a citizenship official instead of another written test.
value_fr: Les demandeurs ont jusqu'à 3 chances de réussir l'examen; après un troisième échec, IRCC convoque une audience avec un agent de la citoyenneté plutôt qu'un autre examen écrit.
note: 'You'll have 3 chances to pass the test' confirmed via live canada.ca results page content, 2026-08-28.

value_en: Applicants aged 18 to 54 (on the day they sign their citizenship application) must take the citizenship test.
value_fr: Les demandeurs âgés de 18 à 54 ans (le jour où ils signent leur demande de citoyenneté) doivent passer l'examen pour la citoyenneté.
note: Verified via live canada.ca content in search index, 2026-08-28.
